secrets.name: BTCPAY_URL
secrets.description: Base URL of your BTCPay Server (e.g. https://pay.example.com). Without it, bitcoin checkout issues sandbox invoices that settle inside this environment only.

secrets.name: BTCPAY_STORE_ID
secrets.description: BTCPay store id whose invoices LocalLoop opens (BTCPay → Stores → your store → Settings).

secrets.name: BTCPAY_API_KEY
secrets.description: BTCPay API key with invoice read/write (BTCPay → Account → API keys).

secrets.name: BTCPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret of the BTCPay webhook pointed at /api/public/btcpay-webhook, used to verify settlements.
